headline: Everything You Need
subheadline: Powerful features to help you build faster and ship with confidence.

features.title: Lightning Fast
features.description: Built on Astro for zero JavaScript by default. Your site loads instantly.

features.title: Block-Based
features.description: Compose your site from pre-built, tested blocks. Add and remove with a single command.

features.title: Beautiful Themes
features.description: Choose from curated palettes or bring your own. Switch themes at runtime.

features.title: i18n Ready
features.description: Built-in internationalization with content collections organized by locale.

features.title: Edge Deployed
features.description: Deploy to Cloudflare Workers for global edge performance out of the box.

features.title: AI-Assisted
features.description: Smart scaffolding with AI that understands your project and suggests the right blocks.
